title: Caleb Williams, several starters will not play for Bears on Saturday

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Caleb Williams, several starters will not play for Bears on Saturday
sources.description: Bears quarterback Caleb Williams will not play in the team's preseason opener against the Browns on Saturday, and it sounds like head coach Ben Johnson is leaning toward not playing the signal-caller at all in August.
